summary: Add a manual display-only offline scoreboard to the existing local Owner PWA and package it as a reversible static subtree update.

evidence.failure: The local Owner PWA had no offline manual score-display action; its existing live standings action depends on a current backend read.
validation: Focused manual-score input and local-overlay contract tests.
Owner PWA local Matrix/AUX regression tests.
